goals.objective:
Objective: Improve the time tracker’s layout, visual hierarchy and UX, and add an automated layout audit so regressions fail verification. Work through the phases in order. After each phase, npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build and (from Phase 0 on) npm run ui:audit must pass.

Previous Context: We have restyled the app using TailwindCSS and shadcn components. See @.agent/screenshots as a sample of how it looks. Now we need to improve the design.

Hard constraints

Same as before: shadcn/ui components only, tokens only (no hard-coded hex in components), no changes to lib/ signatures or removed or weakened tests, no new dependencies except @axe-core/playwright, no git commits, a note in .agent/PROGRESS.md after each phase.
Use US English in all UI copy (“Color”, “Organize”).
Minimum text size is 12px. Muted text must reach a 4.5:1 contrast ratio in both themes.

Phases and acceptance criteria

Layout audit harness
scripts/ui-audit.ts (run by npm run ui:audit) visits every route at 375, 768 and 1280px, in light and dark, and in three states: seeded, empty, and running-timer. It uses a documented seed fixture.
It fails with a nonzero exit if any of these is true: the page scrolls horizontally; any element overflows its nearest card; any text input is narrower than 120px; any button or link on viewports of 768px or less has a hit area under 40×40px; axe reports a violation.
It saves both viewport-height and full-page screenshots to .agent/screenshots/, named <page>-<width>-<theme>-<state>.png.
Initially, the audit is expected to fail on the known bugs below. Record the failures in PROGRESS.md before fixing.
Shell and responsive fixes
At 768px the sidebar becomes an icon rail with tooltips. The full sidebar shows only at 1024px and above.
Sidebar height fills the viewport and stays fixed while content scrolls.
Mobile bottom nav gets bottom padding on the content and a safe-area inset, and never covers the last element.
The top bar shows the page title or breadcrumb on the left and the running-timer indicator and theme toggle on the right.
Categories redesign
The add form is a single row on desktop and wraps cleanly below 640px. The Name input has flex-1 min-w-0 and is at least 200px wide wherever it appears. The color picker opens in a popover instead of showing as inline swatches.
Cards show the color dot, name, hours this week, entry count and a thin share-of-total bar. They have no inline picker.
Card actions live in an overflow menu: Rename, Change color (opens the popover with a confirm step), Delete. Delete keeps the entry-count confirmation dialog.
Swatches in the picker are at least 32px. All cards in a row are equal height.
Dashboard
The timer card is the hero. Idle shows a description input, category select and a large Start button. Running shows a large tabular-nums clock, a pulsing indicator, a Stop button and the elapsed-since-start time.
Stat cards use a 2×2 grid below 768px. A delta appears only when a real comparison exists. Otherwise the dash is removed, not rendered.
The bar chart is stacked by category, includes days with zero entries for the selected range, and has a 7d / 30d / month toggle. X labels read “Thu 22”. Tooltips show per-category durations.
The donut legend is sorted by duration descending, shows “Name · 27%” without wrapping, and shows a clean empty state.
Recent entries has “View all” aligned to the right of the header, and each row shows the time range.
Entries
Filters are one row at 768px and above. Below that, they collapse into a “Filters” button that opens a sheet, with active filters shown as removable chips. “Clear” shows only when a filter is active.
Day headers stick while scrolling. Row hit areas are at least 44px tall on mobile.
Each row’s menu includes Resume (starts a timer with the same description and category), Duplicate, Edit and Delete. Delete keeps the Undo toast.
A currently running timer appears as a live row at the top of Today.
Tests cover Resume, Duplicate, and the filter-chip logic.
Settings
Content is capped at about 720px wide and centered on desktop.
Export and Import are merged into one “Data” card with a data summary (entry and category counts, approximate size).
Import uses a styled drop zone with drag-and-drop and a keyboard-accessible button. The paste-JSON option sits in a collapsed accordion.
Remove the native file input styling. Validation errors show inline.
Typography and contrast
All muted text meets 4.5:1 in both themes, and no text is under 12px.
Spacing uses a consistent scale, and headings use a defined type scale from tokens.
Zero axe violations across all pages, widths and themes in ui:audit.
UX details
document.title shows the running timer (e.g. “● 00:42:10 · Time Tracker”) while a timer is active and resets when it stops.
Keyboard shortcuts: N opens Add entry, and Space starts or stops the timer when focus isn’t in an input. A ? dialog lists them.
First-run state: with no data, the dashboard shows a welcome card with a “Create your first category” step and a “Load sample data” button.
Tests cover the title behavior, the shortcut guards (no firing while typing), and the first-run state.
Final audit
ui:audit passes with no failures on all routes, widths, themes and states.
Produce a .agent/screenshots/INDEX.md listing every screenshot, so review is quick.

Done when: all phases are complete, the full verify command and ui:audit both pass from a clean checkout, and no lib/ signatures or tests changed.
